title: The balanced tripartitioning tensor P₂ has border rank at least 26
statement: Let P_2 = Σ x_A y_B z_C over all ordered partitions (A, B, C) of {1,...,6} into three 2-sets (a 15 × 15 × 15 tensor; Pratt's T_2, the P_2 of Björklund–Kaski–Koana–Nederlof). Then the border rank of P_2 over ℂ (limits in the Euclidean topology) is at least 26, and so is its border rank in the algebraic sense (Σ_{i≤r} u_i(ε)⊗v_i(ε)⊗w_i(ε) = ε^h P_2 + O(ε^(h+1)) with polynomial entries) over every field of characteristic 0 or of prime characteristic q ≤ 31; hence also its rank over these fields. Proof: the Koszul–Young flattening bound of Landsberg–Ottaviani, border rank(T) ≥ rank K_p((Φ⊗1⊗1)T)/C(2p,p), proved in the README over every field, with p = 3 and an explicit integer 7 × 15 projection Φ; the 525 × 525 integer matrix K_3((Φ⊗1⊗1)P_2) has rank 502 modulo 2 and 504 modulo every prime 3 ≤ q ≤ 31, and a rank modulo q is at most the rank over ℚ. With the companion note: 26 ≤ border rank(P_2) ≤ R(P_2) ≤ 29 over ℂ and over every field of characteristic 0 or of prime characteristic 3 ≤ q ≤ 31.
